description_en: Lists the user-defined functions from a database in a data lake
description_zh: 批量获取数据湖中数据库的用户自定义函数列表
name: ListFunctions

parameters.description_en: The ID of the data catalog.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_id

parameters.description_en: A regular expression that filters user-defined functions by name.
parameters.description_zh: 用户定义函数名的正则匹配表达式。
parameters.help_en: A regular expression that filters user-defined functions by name
parameters.help_zh: 用户定义函数名的正则匹配表达式
parameters.name: function_name_pattern

parameters.description_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If the response does not provide this token, pass an empty string ("").

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If the response does not provide this token, pass an empty string ("")
